value.body: A market research analyst designs surveys, gathers data on customers and competitors, and turns it into findings a business can act on. Research agencies, consumer-goods firms, consultancies and analytics teams hire them. Days are spent on questionnaires, cleaning data, running tables and writing reports.

items.label: Typical entry
items.value: BA Economics, BBA, B.Com, B.Sc (Statistics) or an MBA

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Freshers often start as research executives or junior analysts at research agencies, where training on the job is common. A short course in statistics or data tools helps with shortlisting.

value.title: Skills you'll use
items: Cleaning and tabulating data in Excel or SPSS

value.title: At a glance
items: Agency work is project-based with frequent deadlines.
Common next roles: senior analyst, research manager, insights or consumer-strategy roles.
Many analysts move into data analytics as their tool skills grow.
